description_en: Checks whether Auto Scaling is authorized to operate on ECS resources
description_zh: 检测是否已授权弹性伸缩调操作ECS资源
name: VerifyAuthentication

parameters.help_en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: uid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only check the authorization status. Valid values:

true: Only checks the authorization status without creating a service-linked role.
false: Checks the authorization status. If Auto Scaling is not authorized to operate on ECS or Elastic Container Instance (ECI) resources, a service-linked role is associated through automatic creation.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否只检查授权情况。取值范围：

true：只检查授权情况，不创建服务关联角色。
false：检查授权情况，如果弹性伸缩无权限操作ECS或ECI资源，则自动创建服务关联角色。

默认值：false
parameters.name: only_check
